title: Heal behind trees: when the champion would stand to heal while seen, first walk to a spot within 3 s that trees hide from every enemy seeing us (TREE_HEAL_ON)
behaviors: in the champion's standing 'heal' mode (HP < 90%), t >= 10, when an enemy in view sees us by the champion's own test (seenAt cone=true) and trees+buildings do not already hide us from all of them: walk to the nearest in-zone spot 1, 2 or 3 s of walking away (12 bearings, nearest first, straight-line walkable, no closer to any of those enemies) that trees+buildings hide from all of them, then heal there; give up after 3 s without 1 m of progress; off when a drop is near and reachable or a drop run/hold is on
owner: unassigned (research P41-44 trees follow-up; Grok assigns)
next_action: Grok: assign or park. If built: one flag TREE_HEAL_ON default false; trees-on base-0 hazard with fired / different behavior / different score, regen ticks gained, damage taken while healing, drop-ring arrivals, pins >= 20 s with the flag active, deaths < 40 s.
single_decision: Where we stand while healing when seen. Today 'heal' (brain.ts:825-830) stands still; its hide walk runs only while hurt (!noSneak) and only toward building cover (hideSpot, brain.ts:425, building-only seenAt brain.ts:405). This adds one destination type: a tree-hidden spot, used where the champion would stand in the open.
trigger: TREE_HEAL_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND mode === 'heal' (brain.ts:830, standing) AND threats seeing us by seenAt(me.pos, myHeight, [e], true) is non-empty AND NOT (trees+buildings hide us from every such enemy already) AND a tree spot exists (see behavior) AND NOT (near-and-reachable drop OR dropMove OR dropHold).
hook: brain.ts act(), heal branch brain.ts:825-830: when `spot` is null and TREE_HEAL_ON, set `spot = treeSpot(...)` (hideSpot's 12-bearing/1-2-3 s search with the tree-aware hidden test) and keep mode 'heal, hiding' so the existing silent cap applies; a small `settleTree` give-up (3 s no progress, skip list per phase) like P29's settle (brain.ts:850-876). Tree data loaded once in buildBot from hello.map.dir/v2/world.json next to loadMap (brain.ts:265). Flag in params.ts.
gates: Not before t = 10 s. Only in the champion's standing heal mode, which ranks below drop run/hold, engage, retreat, crossfire, ambush and zone travel (brain.ts:751-830), so it never replaces them; plus the near-and-reachable drop gate. Movement has a 3 s no-progress give-up and per-phase skip list (BUILD_CHECKLIST item 4). Off = champion exactly.
drop_gate: Drop gate (Doug 8:58 PM ET rule, near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M): the rule is off on any tick where a drop passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, flat distance <= DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736) or dropMove/dropHold is on, and it yields to a drop run/hold on the same tick. A plain 'no drop listed' gate is not used (an untaken drop sits in obs.drops most of the game; it killed P26b, P33, P29b).
tree_model: Tree cover test (observable: the kit map files hello.map.dir/v2/world.json, 1560 trees, rules.canopyDensity 0.35, canopyBlockT 0.25; protocol.md:369-372, :452): a spot p is hidden from enemy e when both e's eye-to-our-center and eye-to-our-top lines are blocked by a building (map.ts clearLine) or by a tree: a trunk always, canopy only when e is beyond near_range 45 m and the transmittance exp(-0.35 x metres inside crowns) is below 0.25. Shots ignore trees (protocol.md:317), so hiding behind a tree does not stop our own fire.

evidence.protocol: protocol.md:369-372: canopy is soft, trunks block sight, canopy does not block inside near_range 45 m; :317 trees do not stop shots; :452 world.json trees. Our bot never reads trees: map.ts:119 clearLine covers buildings/terrain only, and seenAt (brain.ts:405) and hideSpot (brain.ts:425) use it.
evidence.sim_trees_on: Champion trees-on baselines (/workspace/tester/runs): P29 b6f2f8b mean (16-place) 3.562 -> 3.708 (2000+3000) and 3.870 -> 4.083 (4000+5000) when trees are switched on; deaths before 40 s 56 -> 48 and 54 -> 38. P34 0e6fadd trees on: 3.750 and 4.099, deaths before 40 s 48 and 38. Trees on is now the official screen (coord/WORKFLOW.md 475eb09).
evidence.sim_heal_seen: Trees on, P34 champion: it stands in 'heal' while an enemy sees it by its building-only test in 188/192 (2000+3000) and 178/192 (4000+5000) games; in 91 and 98 of those games trees already hid it at some point (the champion cannot tell).
evidence.sim_deaths: Trees on: 100 of 190 deaths (2000+3000) and 96 of 189 (4000+5000) had a P45 trigger (reach gate) in the 10 s before death.
evidence.watcher: Watcher cover.md / SKILLS.md use building LOS only and treat trees as not cover ('Trees are not cover' in the Watcher methods), so there is no tree-cover Watcher metric (not measured). final_circle.md: top teams are less often in building cover in the final circle (70.6% vs 100%, small n).

trigger_counts_trees_on.gates: Gates as counted: none; plain = obs.drops empty; narrow = no drop (holder null or us) within DROP_RUN_M and no dropMove/dropHold; reach = 'near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M' (Doug 8:58 PM ET follow-up): no drop that passes the champion's own drop-run candidate filter (not in dropSkip, holder null or us, within DROP_RUN_M, zone-safe for lands_in + capture time; brain.ts:731-736 on main 8c130ad) and no dropMove/dropHold that tick. Spec gate = reach.

estimated_activation: 160/192 and 148/192 games (reach gate). Very broad: well above the bar.
closest_prior_test: P24 HEAL_COVER=2 (walk to a short in-zone hide spot before healing; building cover) CLOSE 3.79 vs 4.17 (BB-BE220066), fired 85/192 with 34 worse vs 18 better scores; HEAL_COVER1 (noSneak gap only) parked as the same family. B6 hold behind cover LOSS 2.23. This idea is the same family with a new cover source (trees, which only matter trees-on) and a different spot test; the P24 loss is the main reason to doubt it.
what_would_disprove: Trees-on paired screen: no fall in damage taken while healing or in deaths within 10 s of a heal; drop-ring set totals below the champion, deaths < 40 s above, or new 20 s+ pins with the flag active; an official score at or below the champion. The P24 pattern (more worse than better games) repeating trees on.
risks: Pins: a movement rule; tree spots can sit against trunks or slopes; needs the 3 s give-up and skip list. Drops: gated (near and reachable) and heal ranks below drop run/hold. Early deaths: off before 10 s; walking while hurt draws a step sound within 40 m only above 5 m/s (silent cap applies in 'heal, hiding'). Fire continues (B5b). Broad trigger: changes behavior in most games, so a small per-game loss adds up (P24's failure mode).
